slides.texte_overlay:
what i do the day a teacher
hands back a test

i wait until i'm home to really look at it.
not in the hallway.

i find the question that cost me the most.
that's the one i study first.

i check the corrected version in class.
and copy the right method in my notebook.

i note what went well too.
that's what i keep doing.

then a walk or a short lesson about anything but school.
my head needs air.
slides.texte_sophia:
then a walk, or a short lesson about anything but school
on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app.
my head needs air.

slides.texte_overlay:
and i tell my parents myself.
before the online grade does.
